<style>
  #rk-list-sections--19030312321210__header[hidden] {
    display: none !important
  }
</style>

<script>
  (() => {
    const sectionId = 'shopify-section-sections--19030312321210__header';
    const dropdownId = 'rk-list-sections--19030312321210__header';
    const inputId = 'Search-In-Modal';
    const inputSelector = '';

    const sectionRoot = document.getElementById(sectionId);
    const dropdown = document.getElementById(dropdownId);

    if (!sectionRoot || !dropdown) return;

    const findInput = () => {
      return (
        (inputId && document.getElementById(inputId)) ||
        (inputSelector && sectionRoot.querySelector(inputSelector)) ||
        sectionRoot.querySelector('input[name="q"]')
      );
    };

    const input = findInput();
    if (!input) return;

    const toggleDropdown = (show) => (dropdown.hidden = !show);
    const shouldShowDropdown = () => (input.value?.trim().length ?? 0) > 0;
    const handleInputChange = () => toggleDropdown(shouldShowDropdown());

    ['input', 'focus'].forEach((event) => input.addEventListener(event, handleInputChange));

    sectionRoot.addEventListener('click', ({ target }) => {
      if (target.closest('.reset__button')) toggleDropdown(false);
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', ({ target }) => {
      if (
        dropdown.hidden ||
        target === input ||
        target.closest(`#${dropdownId}`) ||
        target.closest(`#${sectionId} .search-modal__content`)
      )
        return;

      toggleDropdown(false);
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', ({ key }) => {
      if (key === 'Escape') toggleDropdown(false);
    });

    dropdown.addEventListener('click', ({ target }) => {
      if (target.closest('.predictive-search__recommendations-link')) {
        toggleDropdown(false);
      }
    });

    const preSearch = sectionRoot.querySelector('[data-predictive-search]');
    if (preSearch) {
      const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (preSearch.innerText?.trim().length) toggleDropdown(false);
      });

      observer.observe(preSearch, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true,
      });
    }
  })();
</script>

  <path d="M20 12L4 12" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M13 18L20 12L13 6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
</svg></span>

    <script>
      // 2depth button toggle action
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const details = document.querySelectorAll('.local-navigation-bar details');
        details.forEach(function (detail) {
          const submenu = detail.querySelector('.accordion-list');
          if (submenu) {
            const hasActiveSubitem = submenu.querySelector('.local-navigation-bar__subitem--active');
            if (hasActiveSubitem) {
              detail.open = true;
            }
          }
        });
      });
    </script>
